summary: Tested clip renaming system and cross-track drag functionality in Audio Studio. All core features WORKING correctly.

issues: When project state is loaded from backend, only saved tracks are loaded - default tracks (Background Music, Sound Effects) are lost if not saved. Fix: Merge saved tracks with default tracks to ensure all 3 default tracks always exist.

clip_renaming_double_click.details: Double-click on clip name area correctly triggers inline edit mode. Input field appears focused with current clip name pre-filled.

clip_renaming_enter_save.details: Pressing Enter after editing saves the new name. Toast message 'Clip renamed' displayed. Name updates in both timeline clip and Clip Editor panel.

clip_renaming_escape_cancel.details: Pressing Escape after editing cancels the rename operation. Original name is preserved.

clip_renaming_pencil_icon.details: Clicking the pencil (Edit3) icon button on a clip triggers inline edit mode same as double-click.

clip_renaming_editor_panel.details: Editing clip name via the Clip Editor panel input field works. Changes reflect immediately on the timeline.

cross_track_drag.details: Dragging a clip from Voice Track 1 to Test Track 2 successfully moves the clip. Toast message 'Moved clip to Test Track 2' displayed. Clip Editor panel 'Move to Track' dropdown updates to show new track.

track_highlight_during_drag.details: Green border highlight (border-signal-green) appears on target track when dragging clip over it.

same_track_horizontal_drag.details: Dragging clip horizontally within same track repositions it. Toast message 'Clip repositioned' displayed. Start Position in Clip Editor updates.

move_to_track_dropdown.details: Move to Track dropdown in Clip Editor panel shows all available tracks and successfully moves clip when different track selected.

action_items: MINOR: Fix track loading in loadProjectStateAndPendingClips() - should merge saved tracks with default tracks to ensure Background Music and Sound Effects tracks always exist
MINOR: Accessibility warning in console - 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent'
critical_code_review_comments: loadProjectStateAndPendingClips() at line 972-1086: When saved project state has fewer tracks than default, only saved tracks are loaded. Should merge: loadedTracks = defaultTracks.map((def, idx) => ({ ...def, ...projectState.tracks[idx] || {} }))
Two corrupted audio clips (multi-clip-1, multi-clip-2) causing console errors - expected behavior as noted in iteration_3

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All clip renaming and cross-track drag features working correctly

seed_data_creation: Added 'Test Track 2' track for cross-track drag testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Clip renaming (double-click, Enter/Escape, pencil icon, Clip Editor panel) all working. Cross-track drag working with green highlight visual feedback. Same-track horizontal drag working. Note: Project loads with only saved tracks - if user never saved the project with default tracks, Background Music and Sound Effects won't appear. This is a minor issue in loadProjectStateAndPendingClips function.
